title: Opinion: Opinion | Nepal Needs $5 Billion To Rebuild. World's Climate Fund Doesn't Have Even 10% Of It
summary_full: The fund caps support at USD 20 million per project; Nepal needs two hundred times that. And the board is not scheduled to sit until December.
